mapper.sql: o.id, o.run_id, o.enterprise_id, e.name AS enterprise_name, o.project_id, p.project_name, o.signal_id, o.source_record_id, o.total_score, o.grade, o.reason, o.status, o.created_at
FROM crm_lead_observation o JOIN ent_enterprise e ON e.id = o.enterprise_id LEFT JOIN crm_project p ON p.id = o.project_id

where.if: AND (e.name LIKE #{keyword} ESCAPE '!' OR o.reason LIKE #{keyword} ESCAPE '!')

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_lead_observation (run_id, enterprise_id, project_id, signal_id, source_record_id, total_score, grade, reason, status) VALUES (#{runId}, #{enterpriseId}, #{projectId}, #{signalId}, #{sourceRecordId}, #{totalScore}, #{grade}, #{reason}, #{status})
